title: Nuna samfurin ku, farar fata zuwa kantuna, da tsara kwanaki 90
course_title: Fakitin Samfura & Sa alama don Ƙananan Masu samarwa

say: Nuna samfurin ku, farar fata zuwa kantuna, da tsara kwanaki 90.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don Module 4 na Marufi da Samfura.

A cikin wannan kwas ɗin kun yi guntu-guntu da yawa: kit ɗin alama, nau'ikan lakabi, takardar farashi, log ɗin gwaji da duba bin bin doka. Yanzu ja su wuri guda. Ƙirƙiri babban fayil guda ɗaya a cikin Google Drive don aikin.

say: Zainab na da rubuce-rubuce da hotuna da suka watsu a wayarta da hirarrakin WhatsApp. Da rana ɗaya ta ƙirƙiri folder dinta ta ajiye kayanta da tambarin bugawa.
Ta buga takardar kudinta a cikin Google Sheets. Marubucin ya kai kimanin naira 145, kuma cikakken kudinta ya kai kusan naira 610 a kowace raka’a.
Tana sayar da jumloli akan kimanin naira 870, inda farashinsa ya kai kusan 1,100.
Daga baya, lokacin da mai siyan babban kanti ya nemi cikakken bayanin samfurinta, ta aika hanyar haɗin babban fayil guda ɗaya a cikin minti ɗaya.
Yawancin masu siye sun fara saduwa da samfuran ku azaman hoto akan WhatsApp. Saita tebur kusa da taga mai hasken rana kai tsaye. A guji tsattsauran rana tsaka da kwararan rawaya.

say: Don tunawa. Ajiye aikin ku a cikin babban babban fayil mai haske. Hoto a cikin hasken rana. Yi tare da lambobin shagon, kuma ku biyo baya a cikin mako guda. Yarda da sharuɗɗan a rubuce. Kuma saita maƙasudin da za ku iya ƙidaya, kamar kwalabe 70 a mako da rana 90, ba kawai sayar da ƙari ba.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Fayil guda ɗaya bayyananne, fayilolin mai suna tare da sigogin

Yi tare da lambobin dillali

say: Yanzu haɗa babban fayil ɗin aikin ku, ɗaukar fakitin ku kuma farar ku zuwa shagon gaske guda ɗaya, sannan rubuta tunanin ku da shirin kwanaki 90. Kuna buƙatar aƙalla 70% a cikin tambayoyin ƙarshe don takardar shaidar ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
